queries.title: 复购率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN regions AS r
    ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    AND r.region_name = '华东'
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id
) AS t
LIMIT 1000

queries.title: 销量
queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name AS product,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS items_sold
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  items_sold DESC,
  product
LIMIT 5
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_name AS product,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS items_sold
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_id,
    line_amount,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price
  FROM order_items
) AS oi
JOIN (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit_cost,
    unit_price
  FROM products
) AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.product_name
ORDER BY
  items_sold DESC,
  product
LIMIT 5
